name: ramp-feather
why: A floor falling 15 degrees meets a channel's ceiling at y = 1 / tan 15 = 3.732 across the channel: material tapering to nothing, the desk stand's cable-to-slot sliver. A sweep reads whatever it sampled beside the seam (0.142 at 200 samples and 0.096 at 6000 here, 0.007 to 0.304 on the desk stand); the edge search reports the seam itself, at 0, with the planes' own 15.000 degrees, from 200 samples.
